description: Multi-turn discussion of OOP method overriding

turns.content: In Python, how does method overriding work when inheriting from a base class?
Method overriding allows a child class to provide a specific implementation of a method already defined in its parent class.
Can I still call the parent class implementation using super()?
Yes, exactly! You can call `super().method_name()` inside the overridden method.
Could you provide a clean example with an Animal and Dog class?
My systemd service fails to start on boot. Where are the logs located?
You can inspect the logs using `journalctl -u your-service-name.service -e`.
The journalctl log shows 'status 203/EXEC'. What does that error mean?
Error 203/EXEC usually means systemd couldn't find the executable file or the file doesn't have execution permissions.
